name: Explore Curriculum
steps: Read the five-level skill ladder from the public curriculum.
Open /cases/index.json and identify the live case plus available practice levels.
Read only declared public case paths from the index.
Summarize the selected case's public signals, allowed boundary, uncertainty, teaching point, and launch contract.
Follow only launch.path. Treat expected_status 404 as an intentional dead-end exercise and use its declared recovery_path.
output: A concise visible-evidence curriculum or case-library summary.
